Name: Nyapu style Miriam from Two For Joy
Author: DizzyMermaid
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I fell in love with Miriam from the moment I met her, and in my new playthrough where I use Nyapu's portraits, I couldn't bear to be without her! This is my first time ever doing this kind of editing so my apologies if it's sloppy (looking at those eyebrows on her angry portrait...), but I figured if there was anyone else who would benefit from having Miriam in even more games, then I'd help where I could.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is not a Content Patcher mod! It will replace Miriam's original portrait.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Simply download the mod, extract the files, and pop it into your Mods folder - you will be prompted to replace 1 file, which will overwrite Miriam's portrait in the TFJ-Miriam folder.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The original mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42825]Two For Joy![/url] You shouldn't be here without it![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]There's now also a Content Patcher version (thank you DolphinIsNotaFish!) so you'll need Content Patcher for it. Obvs.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68019645]handwrittenhello[/url], the creator of Miriam, for giving us such a wonderful character to love and bring life to the town.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]And of course the biggest credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url] for their fantastic art and permission to use their assets. [/color]
